scenes.title: Corpus Callosum Body · source probability
scenes.prompt: Follow Corpus Callosum Body through all three MRI planes. Rotate the complete source field surface and compare its visible companions.
scenes.note: Original source file: Corpus_Callosum_Body.nii.gz. The probability overlay uses the original fraction values. The 3D surface and binary overlay use the inclusive 0.20 display threshold; overlapping memberships remain independent. The matching MRI consists of an exact original template subarray, with its voxel positions retained.
